title: Volume 1 Chapter 2 — Class 5
content: Early in the morning, I was walking down the school building's corridor with Dr. Allison.
Our destination was the place where the unit I was assigned to received their education—in other words, a classroom.
It seemed that all active Valkyries were female students, and unless they were sorting out, training, or on standby, they apparently attended classes just like ordinary students.
Dr. Allison was wearing a white lab coat over her casual clothes, walking with her hands in her pockets as she conveyed the necessary notifications.
"It will take some time before the machine arrives. Once Dr. Smith is satisfied with the machine's adjustments, it should be transported over together."
Dr. Allison's words contained a slight thorn toward Dr. Smith.

"Until Dr. Smith and the experimental machine arrive, you will be digesting a training menu. Also, you will have to meet the requests from Principal Kase. It would be unbearable if she, who is also the Base Commander, were to get in a bad mood."
Dr. Allison said this while shifting her gaze toward the window.
Even though classes hadn't started yet, the female students had changed into athletic clothes and were working hard at training on the grounds.
However, as expected, it was different from a typical military base.
The training wear they were wearing consisted of short pants and sleeveless tops.
Perhaps noticing that I was watching the state of the grounds, Dr. Allison asked me.
For some reason, she had a smile on her face.
"For someone to deliberately stop and look so intently, you sure are quite curious about them."
Just as Dr. Allison said, I was curious.
"Yes. Since it is currently not training hours, I surmise that they are performing voluntary training. I find the high level of morale at this base to be remarkable."
When I answered seriously, Dr. Allison let out a dry laugh.

"High level of morale, you say? Well, that might be true, but it's fundamentally because the environment they are placed in forces them to be that way. More importantly, don't stare too much. If you are perceived as a pervert, your life at this academy will end on day one."
"Understood. I will be careful."
While maintaining my military posture, I properly looked straight ahead.
As we walked down the corridor while holding such a conversation, we eventually arrived in front of a certain classroom.
The nameplate next to the door read "High School Division — Year 1, Class 5."
"This is your classroom from today onward. Don't look so tense. The instructor has already been informed about you, so just act normally."
"Understood."
When Dr. Allison knocked and opened the sliding door, the inside of the classroom fell dead silent in an instant.
Dozens of pairs of eyes from the female students inside turned to focus entirely on me.
The classroom itself looked exactly like a normal school, but the atmosphere was completely different.
The uniform worn by the girls was a sailor-style uniform with dark blue fabric and white lines, but the design was considerably modern and refined.
Dr. Allison stepped into the classroom first and spoke to the male instructor standing at the podium.
"I have brought the newly assigned test pilot, Hifumi Ren. I leave him in your care."
The instructor nodded and looked at me.
"Understood. Hifumi, come up to the podium and introduce yourself to the class."
"Yes, sir."
I walked up to the podium, stood straight, and saluted the classroom.
"I am Warrant Officer Hifumi Ren, newly assigned as a test pilot for the Prometheus Project. I have been ordered to receive education in this class. Nice to meet you."
The moment I finished my introduction, a loud buzz broke out among the female students.
"A guy? A guy is entering this academy?"
"What is the Prometheus Project anyway?"
"Wait, his rank is Warrant Officer? He's higher rank than us?"
The whispers that immediately filled the room carried clear confusion and wariness.
To them, a male soldier entering their sanctuary was an completely unprecedented event.
The instructor tapped the podium with a clipboard to quiet down the students.

"Quiet down! As of today, Warrant Officer Hifumi will be studying with us. His circumstances are a bit special, but you are to treat him as a classmate. Hifumi, your seat is the empty one by the window at the back."
"Yes, sir."
Walking down the aisle while feeling the intense gazes of the students on my skin, I sat down at the designated desk.
When I looked to the side, the silver-haired girl sitting at the adjacent desk—Louise Durand—smiled gently and waved her hand slightly.
It seemed she was welcoming me, which was a relief since I had expected complete isolation.
The morning classes proceeded smoothly.
The contents of the lectures were mostly about military regulations, strategic theories against the Gijuu, and the fundamental mechanics of forcefields.
For me, who had only received practical, muddy combat training at the infantry facility, these theoretical classes were fresh and highly informative.
When the lunch bell rang, the classroom instantly reverted to a lively state as the girls formed groups to eat together.
I remained seated at my desk, planning to silently eat the simple ration bar I had brought along.
However, Louise stood up from her seat and approached my desk, holding a beautifully wrapped bento box.
"Hello, Ren-kun! Is it okay if I eat lunch here with you?"
I blinked in surprise at her proactive approach.
"I don't mind, but... are you certain it is appropriate for you to mingle with me? The other students seem to be avoiding me."
Louise pulled up a chair and sat down with a bright smile.
"Don't worry about them! Everyone is just surprised because they've never seen a boy on campus before. Besides, we are neighbors now, so it's only natural to be friendly, right?"
As Louise opened her bento box, revealing a colorful array of neatly prepared food, she tilted her head curiously at the plain silver foil package in my hand.
"Is that your lunch, Ren-kun? It looks very... industrial."
"It is standard-issue military combat rations, chocolate flavor. It is designed to efficiently supply necessary calories and nutrition."
Louise gave a slightly strained smile.
"I see... You really are a true soldier, aren't you? If you'd like, you can have some of my tamagoyaki! I made it myself."
Before I could decline, she neatly placed a piece of sweet rolled omelet onto my desk using her chopsticks.
"Thank you. I accept your kindness."
When I picked it up and ate it, a pleasant sweetness spread through my mouth. It was completely different from the dry, artificial taste of the rations I was used to.
As we ate, Louise began sharing some of her trademark trivia, her eyes sparkling with enthusiasm.

"By the way, Ren-kun, did you know? The term 'Valkyrie' originally comes from Old Norse mythology, meaning 'chooser of the slain.' They were divine maidens who led fallen heroes to Valhalla! It's such a cool origin, don't you think?"
"I see. It is a highly fitting name for those who dance in the sky and protect humanity."
Louise looked thrilled that I had actually engaged with her trivia rather than sighing like her other friends.
From a few desks away, Asai Mami was watching our exchange with a cool, unreadable expression.
She didn't approach us, but her sharp eyes remained fixed on me for a long moment before she turned back to her own group.
The afternoon lecture was handled by a strict senior instructor who spoke about the gravity of their roles.

"The organization has invested an astronomical budget into your cultivation," the instructor announced firmly, pacing before the blackboard. "This is because you are valuable combat assets capable of fighting Class 2 Gijuu and above, and at the same time, you are the protectors of the world. I expect you to never throw everything away over temporary emotional lapses."
Hearing the instructor's stern lecture, I recalled my infantry days.
I had rescued fallen Valkyries several times on the front lines, and every single one of them had maintained a cold, distant attitude toward us ground troops.
I had never understood the reason for that severe emotional wall until I heard this lecture.
The instructor's eyes suddenly locked onto me.
"Now then, let's ask Hifumi, who actually operated as an infantryman on the ground, for his impressions. What kind of attitude did the Valkyries you rescued display?"
I stood up straight at my desk to answer.
"Every single Valkyrie I rescued maintained a strict wall against the infantry. ...If I may, sir, I have a question regarding that."
"What is it?"

"On the infantry side, we never heard any talk that having relations with a Valkyrie would result in punishment. There was never an official notification issued to us. Why was it kept hidden from the ground troops?"
The instructor let out a sharp, cynical chuckle at my question.

"If it were poorly publicized, those ground units might try to use clever, underhanded methods to bypass the rules. It's far easier to catch fools who get carried away thinking they can actually date a Valkyrie... that's all there is to it."
A sudden image of Hairset's face flashed through my mind.
If Hairset had ever managed to get close to a Valkyrie, he undoubtedly would have gotten completely carried away and exposed himself immediately, just as the instructor described.
When the final bell rang to signal the end of the school day, the girls began packing their bags and leaving the classroom in scattered groups.
"What are you doing after school?"
"It's right before payday, so I think I need to save my money."
"Right? I really wish payday would hurry up and arrive."
Listening to their normal, everyday conversations, I packed my own belongings to head to the hangar and join the development team.
